The '''TT-17A Elite Vanguard''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] used during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian clans]] along with it's similar counterparts the [[RD-17A]] Master Striker armor and the [[TH-17A Elite War Medic]] armor. The armor sets remained in popularity with the Mandalorians loyal to [[Mandalore the Avenger]] during the [[war against Zakuul]] despite the rise of popularity of the [[Mandalorian Seeker armor]] among the warrior clans.
